en.title: Severe turbulence injures five aboard JetBlue Airbus A320 bound for Fort Lauderdale
en.summary: A JetBlue Airbus A320-200, registration N524JB, operating flight B6-1717 from Ponce, Puerto Rico, to Fort Lauderdale, encountered severe turbulence on November 17, 2026, injuring five people on board; the aircraft continued to Fort Lauderdale and landed safely on runway 10L, and none of the injured was taken to a hospital.
body: A JetBlue Airbus A320-200, registration N524JB, operating flight B6-1717 from Ponce, Puerto Rico, to Fort Lauderdale, Florida, encountered severe turbulence en route on November 17, 2026, causing injuries to five people on board. The aircraft continued to Fort Lauderdale and landed safely on runway 10L. Broward Sheriff Fire Rescue received reports of multiple injuries at approximately 06:25 local time, and the aircraft landed at approximately 06:58 local time and proceeded to Terminal 3, where emergency personnel were standing by.

"JetBlue flight 1717 from Ponce, Puerto Rico (PSE), to Fort Lauderdale (FLL) experienced turbulence during the flight. The aircraft landed safely, where medical personnel evaluated customers and crewmembers for injuries. No one was transported to a hospital. The safety of our customers and crewmembers remains our top priority," JetBlue said in a statement. The Broward Sheriff's Office reported that five people received injuries and were treated at the airport, and that the injured declined transport to a hospital. Authorities reported no structural damage to the aircraft.

facts.claim: A JetBlue Airbus A320-200, registration N524JB, operating flight B6-1717 from Ponce, Puerto Rico, to Fort Lauderdale, encountered severe turbulence en route on November 17, 2026, injuring five people on board.
The aircraft continued to Fort Lauderdale and landed safely on runway 10L.

The Broward Sheriff's Office reported five people received injuries and were treated at the airport, and the injured declined transport to a hospital; the airline said medical personnel evaluated customers and crew members and none was taken to a hospital.

Broward Sheriff Fire Rescue received reports of multiple injuries at approximately 06:25 local time, the aircraft landed at approximately 06:58 local time and proceeded to Terminal 3, and authorities reported no structural damage to the aircraft.

zh.title: 捷藍航空A320遭遇嚴重亂流、5人受傷
zh.summary: 捷藍航空一架空中巴士A320-200客機11月17日執飛B6-1717航班由波多黎各龐塞前往佛州勞德岱堡，途中遭遇嚴重亂流造成機上5人受傷；飛機繼續飛往目的地，在勞德岱堡10L跑道安全降落，傷者均未送醫。
body: 捷藍航空一架空中巴士A320-200客機（註冊編號N524JB）於2026年11月17日執飛B6-1717航班，由波多黎各龐塞前往佛羅里達州勞德岱堡，途中遭遇嚴重亂流，造成機上5人受傷。飛機繼續飛往目的地，在勞德岱堡10L跑道安全降落。布勞沃德郡消防救援單位在當地時間約06:25接獲多起受傷通報，飛機約06:58降落後滑往第三航站，由待命的急救人員接應。
布勞沃德郡警長辦公室表示，5名傷者在機場接受治療後拒絕送醫；捷藍航空證實，醫護人員在降落後為乘客與機組人員檢查傷勢，無人送醫。當局表示飛機沒有結構損傷。
